title: Tide and Terrace – Rosemary Beach®
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Tide and Terrace | Elevated Luxury in the Heart of Rosemary Beach

Experience Rosemary Beach from one of its most unique residences. Perfectly positioned above Barrett Square, 6 Barrett Place offers an exceptional blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience—highlighted by one of the largest private rooftop terraces in Rosemary Beach. Whether you're enjoying sunrise coffee, sunset lounging, or cocktails under the stars, this remarkable outdoor retreat creates an unforgettable setting for your beach vacation.

Located just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, boutique shopping, award-winning restaurants, this beautifully appointed condominium places everything you love about 30A right outside your door.

Inside, the open-concept living space is designed for gathering. Natural light pours through expansive windows, while comfortable furnishings, sophisticated coastal décor, and seamless access to the rooftop terrace create an inviting atmosphere for relaxing after a day at the beach. The gourmet kitchen features premium Viking appliances, marble countertops, and everything needed to prepare everything from a quick breakfast to an elegant family dinner.

The spectacular rooftop terrace is truly the centerpiece of the home. Designed as an outdoor living room, it offers multiple spaces to dine, lounge, and unwind, complete with beautiful landscaping, soothing fountains, ambient lighting, and panoramic views across Rosemary Beach. It's the perfect place to enjoy both sunrise and sunset without ever leaving home.

Sleeping accommodations comfortably host up to six guests:

• Primary Suite – King bed with a private en suite bathroom

• Guest Bedroom – Queen bed

• Guest Bedroom – Two twin beds

• Shared full bathroom

During your stay, enjoy exclusive access to Rosemary Beach's exceptional amenities, including four resort-style community pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center, tennis courts, scenic walking paths, parks, and private beach access.

Additional amenities include:

• One of Rosemary Beach's largest private rooftop terraces

• Gourmet kitchen with Viking appliances

• Covered reserved parking

• Elevator access

• Two complimentary bicycles

• Washer and dryer

• High-speed Wi-Fi

• Smart TVs

• Steps from Barrett Square shopping and dining

• Short walk to the beach and community pools

Whether you're planning a family getaway, couples' retreat, or relaxing week along Scenic Highway 30A, 6 Barrett Place offers an elevated Rosemary Beach experience where luxury, location, and unforgettable outdoor living come together.

RENTS SATURDAY TO SATURDAY IN SPRING BREAK & SUMMER

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on building during January-August 2026.
